name: @the-inclusionist/game-2048
description: 2048 · Potência de 2 — a sliding-merge number puzzle on the accessibility-first Inclusionist engine. Reimplemented from the rules, not forked from any of the MIT descendants of Threes!.
comment:publishConfig: ⚠️ WITHOUT THIS LINE A SCOPED PACKAGE IS PUBLISHED RESTRICTED. npm's default for `@scope/name` is
`restricted`: on a free organisation `npm publish` fails with 402, and on a paid one it SUCCEEDS and
the package is private — the platform's install would 404 with nothing to read. The engine carries the
same line, which is why it installs at all.
📌 And publishing AGPL code privately is a contradiction: the licence exists to keep the Município's
work reachable by whoever receives it.
comment:name: Package `@the-inclusionist/game-2048` (ADR-0068 §3 with ADR-0071's scope) in repository
`the-inclusionist/game-2048` (ADR-0081). They MIRROR each other, so there is nothing to hold in the head.
⚠️ This paragraph used to justify a DIVERGENCE, and there is none left to justify. The repository was
`pixi-2048` until 2026-09-06 and the two names pointed different ways; ADR-0081 superseded that choice
whole. The chess did the same — it is `the-inclusionist/game-chess` now, not `hartwig-zdog-chess` — so
`game-<slug>` is what both game repositories carry. The reason the short form works is ADR-0071 §1's:
inside the organisation the container is already named, so `the-inclusionist/the-inclusionist-game-2048`
would say the word twice.
comment:private: `private: true` UNTIL there is something to publish. ADR-0068 §3 says a game publishes itself as a
package so the catalogue's manifest can select it, and that day this line comes off — with the same
care the engine's did (ADR-0072 §4). A scaffold that could be published by accident is worse than one
that cannot be published at all.

scripts.build: vite build && node scripts/post-build-cloudflare.mjs && vite build --mode cartridge
scripts.test:a11y: node scripts/pwa-check.mjs && node scripts/layout-check.mjs && node node_modules/@the-inclusionist/engine/scripts/check-cartridge.mjs && node scripts/axe-check.mjs
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && vitest run && npm run build

comment:dependencies: THE ENGINE COMES FROM THE REGISTRY since 2026-09-06 — `@the-inclusionist/engine` is published on npmjs
(ADR-0072), and this is ADR-0068 §3's mechanism working: a game depends on the engine as a VERSIONED
package. It used to be `file:../SP-the-inclusionist-tracer`, and switching was the first honest test of
⚠️ AND THE CLAIM THIS PARAGRAPH USED TO MAKE WAS FALSE. It said `the day the engine is published, this
line becomes a semver range and nothing else in this repository changes`. Three things changed: the
contract's `topology` became a method, a required `world()` field appeared, and the `grid` topology
gained `size`/`move`/`frame`. None of that was visible through a `file:` link into a folder somebody
else was editing — which is exactly what a link into a moving target hides.
⚠️ AND A FOURTH, ON 7.0.1: `@mintplex-labs/piper-tts-web` was a stopgap dependency HERE for one day,
because the engine shipped it as a devDependency and no consumer could build. The engine did not move it
to `dependencies` as I had proposed — it turned the neural voice into an injected PORT (ADR-0094), which
is the better fix: naming the provider would force 135.4 MB of onnxruntime-web on every consumer. The
stopgap is gone, and this game declines the port on purpose — see `boot/main.ts`.
`pixi.js` is pinned to the engine's EXACT version: two PixiJS in one page is a bug, not a fallback.
